about:
# Startpos New Best Popup

Shows a <cy>**NEW BEST**</cy> popup from start positions

You must have [Death Tracker](mod:elohmrow.death_tracker) mod installed, this mod uses it

## Features:

- Minimum run length to show popup
- Death Tracker level linking support
- Configure label template and popup duration
- Cheat detection like in Death Tracker
